context: A maintainer asks whether a positive pooled average in a 2024 review warrants routine VARK matching.

proposal.proposed_change: Recommend matching instruction to a fixed learning-style label for every learner.
proposal.prediction: Matching improves delayed unassisted learning across style groups.
proposal.evaluation_needed: Well-powered crossover design with the same delayed outcome in matched and unmatched conditions for each style group.
proposal.reason: The inspected 2024 abstract reports a positive pooled average, but only 26% of outcome measures support the required crossover for at least two styles, and its authors cite low study quality. The abstract provides no basis for a universal rule.

future_reconsideration: Reopen if higher-quality crossover studies with delayed learning outcomes materially change the evidence.

resumed_proposal.trigger: The same 2024 abstract was offered again without new crossover data.
resumed_proposal.reason: The proposal has the same evidence and population as the rejected attempt; no material condition changed.

scope: Synthetic evaluation fixture, not a conducted learner study
